geometry.cross_section: FCC sites within a circular cut; discrete stepped surface
geometry.vacuum_definition: 5 A padding on each side of the nominal cut; nominal image gap 10 A
geometry.topology_policy: common dimensionless parent scaled to each method bulk a0
geometry.cell_dof: zz only; xy lengths and all tilts fixed
geometry.interpretation: pilot only: vacuum, axial period, grid/k-point convergence not yet demonstrated

cell.stress_gate: zz only; lateral stresses recorded, not relaxed

protocol.numerical_provenance: September15 LDA/local lambda=.9,mu=.1 grid test: 60 to 78 changes Eb(1NN) by -0.1705 meV and Eb(2NN) by -0.0759 meV; September16 EOS 78 vs96 gives da0=4.97e-6 A and dB0=0.000627 GPa. Fixed point count retained through variable-cell trajectory; actual spacing recorded. OF density grid is not QE wavefunction cutoff. Nano grid selected at <=0.15 A initial spacing; this is a pilot, not a completed vacuum-grid convergence test.
protocol.comparison_scope: User explicitly retains different XC/pseudopotentials: QE PAW/PBE versus OF local/LDA. Compare within-method formation/binding energies and structures, never subtract raw absolute total energies across methods.
